rows.source: Compacted soil loses its air spaces. Roots slow down. Water soaks in differently. The bed gets harder to work every season.
rows.current: Compacted soil loses its air spaces. Midzi i aluwa nga u ongolowa. Maḓi a nwela nga nḓila yo fhambanaho. Bed gets harder to work kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe.
rows.originalProposal: Mavu o petetsanaho a xedza zwikhala zwa muya. Midzi i aluwa nga u ongolowa. Maḓi a nwela nga nḓila yo fhambanaho. Bed i a konḓa u shuma khayo kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe.
rows.recommendedTarget: Mavu o petetsanaho a xedza zwikhala zwa muya. Midzi i aluwa nga u ongolowa. Maḓi a nwela nga nḓila yo fhambanaho. Bed gets harder to work kha khalaṅwaha iṅwe na iṅwe.
rows.backtranslation: Compressed soil loses air spaces. Roots grow slowly. Water enters differently. Bed is hard to work in each season.

rows.source: Others do better with a protected start in a nursery, then transplanting. Tomatoes and brassicas belong there.
rows.current: Tse ding do better ka qalo e sireletsehileng ho nursery, ebe transplanting. Tomatoes le brassicas ke tsa sehlopha seo.
rows.originalProposal: Tse ding di hola hantle ho feta ha di qala di sireletsehile ka nursery, ebe di a fetisetswa. Tomatoes le brassicas ke tsa sehlopha seo.
rows.recommendedTarget: Tse ding do better ka qalo e sireletsehileng ho nursery, ebe transplanting. Tomatoes le brassicas ke tsa sehlopha seo.
rows.backtranslation: Others grow better when they begin protected in a nursery, then are transferred. Tomatoes and brassicas are of that group.
rows.reason: Grow better narrows broad do better to growth. Fetisetswa means transferred, not reliably transplanting. Preserve existing localized prefix/condition/then/classification and exact do better/transplanting anchors; no demonstrated need to replace them.

rows.source: Others do better with a protected start in a nursery, then transplanting. Tomatoes and brassicas belong there.

rows.originalProposal: Swin'wana swibyariwa swi kula ku antswa loko swi sungula swi sirhelelekile eka nursery, kutani swi hundziseriwa. Tomatoes na brassicas swi wela eka ntlawa wolowo.
rows.recommendedTarget: Swin'wana do better loko swi sungula swi sirhelelekile eka nursery, kutani transplanting. Tomatoes na brassicas swi wela eka ntlawa wolowo.
rows.backtranslation: Other crops grow better when they begin protected in a nursery, then are transferred. Tomatoes and brassicas belong to that group.
rows.reason: Growth narrows performance, hundziseriwa generic transfer loses technical transplanting. Added swibyariwa unnecessary; keep exact current prefix and localized condition/then/classification.

rows.source: Others do better with a protected start in a nursery, then transplanting. Tomatoes and brassicas belong there.
rows.current: Others do better with a protected start in a nursery, then transplanting. Tomatoes na brassicas zwi wela henefho.
rows.originalProposal: Zwiṅwe zwimela zwi aluwa zwi khwine musi zwi tshi thoma zwo tsireledzea kha nursery, zwa pfuluselwa. Tomatoes na brassicas zwi wela henefho.
rows.recommendedTarget: Zwiṅwe do better musi zwi tshi thoma zwo tsireledzea kha nursery, nga murahu transplanting. Tomatoes na brassicas zwi wela henefho.
rows.backtranslation: Other plants grow better when they start protected in a nursery, [and] are moved. Tomatoes and brassicas belong there.
rows.reason: Aluwa narrows performance to growth; pfuluselwa movement does not guarantee transplanting; zwa lacks explicit then. Translate Others/protected framing with exact do better and transplanting anchors and explicit afterwards, retaining classification.
